I bought this foam mattress hoping for better sleep, but it has been a disappointment from night one. The mattress is much firmer than advertised and feels more like a slab than a comfortable mattress. Within a few weeks I noticed permanent indentations where I sleep, which has only made my back pain worse. The cover material is cheap and started pilling after a couple of washes. I also noticed a faint but persistent chemical smell that took nearly a month to fade. Motion transfer is terrible—my partner moves and I feel every shift across the bed. Customer service was slow to respond and offered minimal help when I reported these issues. Overall, I expected higher quality for the price and would not recommend this mattress.
